title: Subjectivity-Intersection Braid Quantum Gravity: A Constructive Refutation of Objectivist Primacy from Source-Derived Quantum Dynamics to the Einstein Limit
description: We develop Subjectivity-Intersection Braid Quantum Gravity as a mathematically explicit candidate in which a public Lorentzian spacetime carrier is generated by intersections of nonidentical, standpoint-bearing pointed-Braid processes. Version 0.82 retains the complete v0.81 finite Lorentz parent, four-component Ward identity, one-cycle CPTP backreaction, scoped Einstein equation G=(3/5)T, and two-helicity spin-2 limit. It adds a scoped derived anomaly-solution transformation groupoid: three identical anomaly-free Standard-Model chiral character copies, the global [SU(3) x SU(2) x U(1)]/Z6 quotient, one independent complex weak Higgs doublet, and source-cubic up/down/charged-lepton Yukawa interaction types. The unchanged source remains non-Standard-Model-equivalent. Masses, mixing, vacuum dynamics, gravitational first-class constraints, ultraviolet completion, calibrated predictions, and empirical validation remain open. The included calibration item is an unexecuted external preflight; Newton's constant is an input, not a prediction.
